description: Skyway Air support documentation and staff discussion about changing a booking.

files.description: A Confluence page in the customer-policies space for support agents about changing a booking, last updated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15. It must contain these sentences word for word: "$75 per passenger plus the fare difference"; "a lower fare gives nothing back on Standard"; "on Flex a lower fare comes back as travel credit"; "Basic fares cannot be changed"; "label the ticket change-denied". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
